title: Largest Sum of Averages
description: Partition an array into at most K adjacent non-empty groups to maximize the sum of the averages of each group.
pseudocode:
1. dp[k][i] = max(dp[k-1][j] + avg(j, i))
2. for k from 1 to K:
3.   for i from 1 to N:
4.     for j from 0 to i-1:
5.       dp[k][i] = max(dp[k][i], dp[k-1][j] + (sum[i]-sum[j])/(i-j))

steps.note: Initializing DP table for K=2 groups, input [9,1,2,3]
Splitting at index 1: group1=[9], group2=[1,2,3]. Averages: 9 + 2 = 11
Splitting at index 2: group1=[9,1], group2=[2,3]. Averages: 5 + 2.5 = 7.5
Max sum found is 11, finalizing result.
